thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 P1 ALERT — /v1/generate 5xx spike in apac during blue/green rollout. Error rate 40% -> paging @oncall-eng. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/rollout-drift
oncall-eng: Acked. Jumping in. Can someone post the metrics URL and the rollout ID?
sre-lead: I'm on path — looks like partial traffic shift to green pool at 12:02 UTC (rollout id r-2026-03-17-66). Sending link to dashboards: https://dashboards.internal/apac/inference-api/errors (spike at 12:03).
oncall-eng: Copy. Initial triage: 502 and upstream 524s, all coming from green nodes. Logs show "kv-cache-mismatch" errors intermittently.
support-liaison: Customer impact: a few high-throughput customers see 50% request errors (ua: acme-inc, wyvern-ai). Pager duty messages started at 12:04. No billing impact yet, but API SLA at risk.
pm-jordan: Do we have a fast kill-switch? If green is bad, we should flip weights back to blue. Need CI approval?
sre-lead: We have two quicker options: 1) routing kill: set region weight back to blue; 2) feature-flag rollback for new routing mesh. Recommend route weight flip first (lowest blast).
ops-backfill: I'm ready to execute route weight flip. Command (console):
```
redwoodctl route set-weight --region apac --blue 100 --green 0 --reason "auto rollback - high 5xx" --who oncall-eng
```
ops-backfill: will run after confirmation from oncall-eng.
oncall-eng: Run it. I'm confirming with SRE.
ops-backfill: running...
ops-backfill: output: {"status":"accepted","operation":"route-weight","id":"op-9876"}
incident-bot: Automated: started traffic shift op-9876 -> expected cutover 30s.
sre-lead: Watching error rate...
(30s pass)
sre-lead: Error rate dropping from 40% -> 7% now. Latency back to normal on blue. Green still showing 502s for health checks but traffic is drained.
support-liaison: Customer update: sent notice to affected customers that we rolled back traffic and are investigating root cause.
pm-jordan: Good. Start bridge and postmortem owner? @alice can you take lead?
alice: I’ll own the postmortem. Will collect logs and config diffs. Assigning follow-ups: verify cache sync, reproduce locally, and add automated canary gating for KV schema changes.
sre-lead: Preliminary root cause: deployment to green included a KV schema patch that was incompatible with existing cache warmers in apac edge nodes, causing cache misses and backend timeouts. Next step: confirm deploy artifact and rollback patches.
oncall-eng: Are we sure this is schema? I see a small heartbeat gap between control plane and green pool during the shift — some routers kept sending old cache keys. Could be race between rollout and cache warmers.
ops-backfill: Collected node logs and control plane trace: `/var/log/redwood/route.log` shows repeated `cache_miss -> fallback-> upstream-timeout`. Saving to S3: s3://incidents/3640012345/logs.tar.gz
incident-bot: Note: automatic post-incident metrics snapshot saved.
sre-lead: Actionables: (1) Disable automatic rollout gates for KV schema changes until gated tests added. (2) Add pre-shift cache-warm verification step. (3) Run canary longer (5m) for apac.
pm-jordan: Agree. Also add customer communication draft and timeline.
support-liaison: Customers notified; support queue triaged; no open escalations now.
oncall-eng: Handing off to daytime oncall in 15m. I'll document exact commands used and the op id.
alice: Will schedule hotfix: temporarily revert schema change and run controlled rollout to staging then to apac. Owner: alice. ETA investigation doc by EOD.
sre-lead: Closing the page — service restored to normal for apac. Will reopen if errors creep above 2% again.
incident-bot: Incident status: RESOLVED -> partial-rollback to blue. Timeline and artifacts: s3://incidents/3640012345/, op id op-9876, rollout r-2026-03-17-66.
ops-backfill: Final note: remember to add a post-check that validates no 5xx spike for 10m after weight flip.
alice: Postmortem owner assigned. Will create doc and send to triage channel. Thanks team :heart:
pm-jordan: Great work, everyone.
